business_scope.primary_industry_name: Real Estate Property Management and Rental Screening Cloud

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law, French civil law and customary law; Constitution of Vanuatu 1980 art. 95)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus)
Tax Information Exchange Agreements with Australia, New Zealand, Denmark and other G20 partners (no double tax treaties in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [CAP 222] as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018; Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2002; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [CAP 250]; VFSC AML/CFT Rules and Registered Agent Directives; UBO records are held by the licensed registered agent in Vanuatu and disclosed to VFSC/FIU on lawful request.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Private_Nominee_Friendly (non-public UBO register; VFSC and Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit have access on lawful request; nominee shareholders require disclosure of beneficial owner to the agent)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority of the country of origin; certificate page notarized by a local notary public or equivalent authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the origin country is an Apostille Contracting State; otherwise consular legalization at the nearest Vanuatu embassy/high commission/honorary consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or account-holding bank in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization as prescribed for the document's origin country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original banker's reference letter (dated within six months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution maintaining the UBO's or corporate shareholder's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank signature authenticated by notary; apostille/consular legalization required if requested by the registered agent or VFSC

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of wealth and source of funds declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: UBO or authorized corporate officer; sworn/declared before a notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and Hague Apostille or consular legalization where the document will be relied on for enhanced due diligence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate organizational chart and ownership breakdown (if a legal person is UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or external legal counsel of the parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized and apostilled or consular legalized; additionally certified by the parent entity's registered agent if the parent is in a foreign offshore jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every shareholder, director, UBO and signatory against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU/UK/NZ sanctions lists, Vanuatu FIU domestic countermeasures list and any list adopted by VFSC; PEP screening uses an automated risk engine plus manual open-source verification of roles, reputational media checks and details of politically connected family members; a PEP match or sanctioned-party hit requires written enhanced due diligence, source of funds evidence and escalation to the VFSC Money Laundering Reporting Officer before any name clearance or incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: VFSC Corporate and International Companies Registry (E-Registry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be submitted in Latin script. Vanuatu's official languages are Bislama, English and French; a name in any other script must be accompanied by a professionally transliterated Latin-script version acceptable to the Registrar. The name must end with 'International Company', 'IC', 'Société Internationale', or an equivalent abbreviation permitted by the International Companies Act; it must not be obscene, misleading, identical or confusingly similar to an existing protected name on the VFSC register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name rejection notice is issued in writing by VFSC stating the statutory basis for refusal. The applicant, through its licensed registered agent, may file an administrative appeal within 14 days of the rejection date, using the agent's VFSC portal account, with a written statement of grounds, a statutory appeal fee, and, if the refusal is based on a prohibited token, prior written consent from the competent regulator (e.g. Reserve Bank of Vanuatu for banking or insurance terms). If the appeal fails, the applicant may immediately submit fresh one-name or multi-name reservation applications; the 30-day reservation period does not run during appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is permissible only where a licensed Vanuatu registered agent maintains the statutory physical registered office address, accepts process service and receives regulatory mail on behalf of the IC. A zero-asset virtual office is acceptable for a PropTech SaaS IC that is merely a tax-exempt holding, licensing/billing shell; it does not create corporate income tax exposure but will not satisfy economic substance tests in foreign jurisdictions if the SaaS contracts are managed or performed in Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for this non-licensed standard-risk IC: approximately 2-5% per year for an unannounced VFSC inspection at the registered agent's premises or registered office; inspection probability increases only on an adverse risk event, sanctions/PEP match, or complaint.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (Cap. 222), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act, particularly sections 5 to 18 regarding incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, and registration of an International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Register, Bougainville House, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation issued upon filing of the Memorandum and Articles of Association (Form IC-1) and statutory declarations through a licensed registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed by the International Companies Act; no escrow or capital deposit is required. The authorized capital is set in the Memorandum and Articles, and at least one subscriber share must be issued before the Certificate of Incorporation is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the International Company be and are hereby adopted, and that the subscribers' subscription to the initial issued ordinary shares is approved. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office in Vanuatu shall be at the address of the licensed registered agent, and that such agent is appointed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed as Director, and [Name] as Secretary, each to hold office until the next annual meeting. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Directors are authorized to open bank accounts, acquire accounting services, and take all steps necessary to obtain the certificate of incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Register — Corporate Registry Window / VFSC digital filing system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed English name together with a name search request to the VFSC International Companies Registry. The name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered entity and must not contain a prohibited word listed under Section 8 of the International Companies Act. The reserved name is held for 28 days.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of passport of the subscriber shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is queried for similarity or undesirability, the applicant may submit up to three alternative names within 10 working days; no additional government fee is charged for the first alternative name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Execute Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent acting as subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the statutory form required under the International Companies Act, inclusive of the company name, registered office clause, authorized capital, objects, and subscriber shares. The subscriber and proposed director sign each page in the presence of a notary or authorized witness; the registered agent countersigns to certify compliance.
required_dossiers: Signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of each proposed director and secretary
Certified copy of passport and proof of residential address of each officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry returns the constitutional documents for substantive correction, the registered agent may amend the affected schedules, re-execute the signature pages, and re-submit through the same licensed agent within 14 days without restarting the name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the completed Form IC-1, executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, consents, subscriber declaration, and registered agent certificate through the VFSC online filing portal or directly at the registry counter. The filing officer performs statutory due diligence, verifies director/shareholder details, and checks compliance with the International Companies Act.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 signed by the registered agent
Statutory declarations of first director and secretary
Certificate of due diligence of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a query or letter of non-compliance is issued, the registered agent must respond in writing within 14 days, supply the missing clarification, pay any remedial fee if required, and the application is then placed in queue for expedited review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Government Fees and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Finance Department / Treasury Payment Counter
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval of the application, the VFSC issues an invoice for the incorporation fee and annual licence fee. Payment is made by bank transfer, card, or licensed agent's escrow account. After payment is cleared, the Certificate of Incorporation is stamped, signed by the Registrar, and issued to the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Payment receipt or bank transfer confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is not reflected within the SLA, provide the bank transaction record; the VFSC finance office will reconcile the remittance and reissue the certificate within 3 working days. If the certificate is physically lost, apply for a certified copy under Section 24 of the Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Registered Office, Statutory Registers, and Corporate Governance Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent / VFSC Corporate Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Certificate of Incorporation is issued, the registered agent files the registered office confirmation, opens the statutory registers of members, directors, and secretary, and issues share certificates to the subscriber. The first board resolution is then minuted, and the registered agent maintains the official records in Port Vila in accordance with the International Companies Act.
required_dossiers: Registered office acceptance letter of the agent
Register of members with share allotment details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent rejects any governance document as incomplete, the company has 7 days to revise the minute book or share allotment table; a new agent can be substituted by filing Form RA-2 and paying the standard administrative fee of US$150.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial or manufacturing licensing authority is required for an ISIC 6201 PropTech/Rental Screening SaaS business conducted as an offshore International Company.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — an International Company is not required to hold a domestic operating licence for purely offshore software services; however, if a physical office were opened in Vanuatu, a standard Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap. 113] would be required from the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — office-based software development and cloud services do not require an EIA; no Category 1 or Category 2 EIA certificate is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; the company's virtual operations generate no industrial wastewater, VOCs, or hazardous waste. If a physical office with more than 10 employees is established, VEPA zero-discharge waste handling and town sewer connection standards would apply to routine sanitary wastewater.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety or structural clearance is required for a remote-offshore SaaS operation. In the event of a physical office, the Vanuatu Fire Service must certify fire prevention measures, Vanuatu Public Works Department must inspect structural load and occupancy limits, and the Department of Employment enforces workplace safety under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 2013 before the first employee occupies the premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: https://www.vrca.gov.vu (VRCA e-Services for VAT registration, returns, and payments).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Vanuatu International Company (IC) is incorporated by a licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act Cap 222 and obtains a Certificate of Incorporation from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). No income tax registration or TIN is required because the IC is statutorily exempt from all taxes, including income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty, and VAT, in respect of its business operations. If the IC engages in local taxable activity above the VAT threshold or voluntarily opts into the VAT net, it must apply to the VRCA using Form VAT-01, attaching the VFSC incorporation certificate, registered agent confirmation, and evidence of business premises, whereupon the VRCA issues a VAT registration number. The VFSC corporate register reference serves as the sole statutory identifier for tax-exempt offshore operation; no separate TIN is issued.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone - Vanuatu International Company (VU_IC); statutorily exempt from all national taxes on offshore business activities, with no residency-based territorial taxation, no income tax, no capital gains tax, no withholding tax, and no wealth or inheritance tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No income-tax check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election machinery exists in Vanuatu because the jurisdiction imposes no direct income tax. Available elections are limited to: (1) voluntary VAT registration under the Value Added Tax Act Cap 250 for local suppliers; (2) conversion of an International Company to a local company under the Companies Act Cap 191, which elects into ordinary local tax/VAT treatment and extinguishes the IC statutory exemption; and (3) application to the VFSC Registrar for a Certificate of Tax Exemption confirming the IC's exempt status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) - Value Added Tax Act Cap 250 (enacted 1998, as amended), administered by the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Compulsory registration applies to a person whose annual taxable turnover of goods and services exceeds VUV 5,000,000 in any twelve-month period; voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold. A Vanuatu International Company engaged exclusively in offshore SaaS/PropTech subscriptions to non-residents is outside the local VAT net and is not obliged to register; local supply of property-management services to VUV-resident clients would be scrutinized against the VUV 5,000,000 nexus threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No national real-time e-invoicing, continuous transaction control (CTC), fiscal clearance API, or digital stamping regime is currently mandated in Vanuatu. VAT-registered entities must issue tax invoices and retain accounting records in accordance with the VAT Act Cap 250; there is no government API clearance or mandated third-party clearance infrastructure. VRCA has announced phased modernization of revenue administration, but e-invoicing remains voluntary/advisory in nature as of the current filing season.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: zero-rated where the supplier holds a customs export declaration and documentary evidence that the goods were exported within the timeframe prescribed by the Commissioner of VRCA. Services: zero-rated where the services are supplied to a non-resident who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply and the services are consumed wholly outside Vanuatu; software-as-a-service subscriptions, cloud-based PropTech screening, and real-estate rental analytics supplied to overseas clients qualify as exported services. The Vanuatu International Company is statutorily exempt from VAT altogether, so zero-rating is claimed only where the IC has voluntarily registered; in that case, the IC must zero-rate qualifying offshore supplies and may claim input credits for attributable local purchases. Failure to substantiate export status converts the zero-rated supply into an exempt or taxable supply with mandatory VAT output tax and clawback risk.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Vanuatu Customs ECS/declaration entry with export confirmation stamp)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export of goods from Vanuatu
Commercial invoice or tax invoice describing the exported goods or exported services
Signed contract or service agreement confirming non-resident customer and offshore consumption for SaaS/PropTech services
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCA is empowered to audit zero-rated export transactions, request underlying contractual and payment evidence, and retrospectively assess VAT on supplies lacking adequate export substantiation. Legal consequences under the VAT Act Cap 250 include additional tax at 25% per annum on unpaid VAT, penalty tax up to 200% of the evaded amount for fraudulent or negligent underpayments, fines of up to VUV 200,000, and imprisonment of up to two years for persons who make false declarations or knowingly produce forged export documentation. Refunds improperly obtained are subject to clawback with compound interest from the original date of refund. For the statutorily exempt Vanuatu International Company, no VAT return or refund claim is ordinarily required, but any voluntary VAT registration exposes the entity to the full audit, clawback, and criminal penalty framework; the 180-day figure reflects the standard banking/trade-finance expectation for export proceeds repatriation, as Vanuatu imposes no statutory FX control deadline for offshore international company revenue.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 65]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) administers financial licensing and AML/KYC matters.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is a managed currency with restricted offshore deliverability; convertibility is freely available for current-account service receipts through authorized dealers, while capital-account transactions generally require RBV approval. However, International Companies registered under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] are considered non-resident and are exempt from the Exchange Control Act in respect of foreign-currency accounts and overseas transactions, allowing the PropTech SaaS business to invoice in USD/AUD/EUR and maintain offshore liquidity with no VUV conversion burden. There are no income taxes, corporate profits taxes, withholding taxes, capital gains taxes, or dividend taxes imposed on International Companies, so profit remittance is not constrained by tax clearance requirements; remittance flows are governed solely by bank-level anti-money-laundering due diligence.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The statutory export-proceeds surrender regime applies to tangible merchandise exporters under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 65], which obliges tangible-goods exporters to repatriate proceeds within the RBV-published realization period (generally six months from shipment) and to offer the VUV equivalent to an authorized dealer. Electronic services, software-as-a-service subscriptions, and intangible-export receipts are not within the goods-surrender rules; accordingly, the ISIC 6201 PropTech SaaS International Company may retain 100% of foreign-currency receipts in any permitted jurisdiction without mandatory conversion. No surrender form or VUV conversion ratio applies to this revenue model; remittance of dividends, royalties, or subcontractor payments follows contractual payment instructions through SWIFT with appropriate narrative.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Corporate Operational Account in USD and VUV
Operational Account in USD, EUR, and VUV
Operational Account in VUV with limited foreign-currency overlay
Operational Account / Foreign Currency Deposit Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MODERATE-to-HIGH through offshore-licensed digital e-money institutions, but LOW if the EMI requires a Vanuatu national payment license. A non-resident International Company may lawfully subscribe to foreign EMIs (e.g., UK- or Singapore-licensed electronic money institutions) for treasury rails, contracted outside Vanuatu; however, any money transmission service carried on in or from Vanuatu requires a VFSC Financial Dealers license under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap. 70]. Because the target payment rails include Stripe_Billing and ACH_Direct, the treasury blueprint should place merchant/deposit accounts in a supported foreign jurisdiction (United States, United Kingdom, or Singapore) and only use Vanuatu bank accounts for settlement sweeps, thereby avoiding unlicensed onshore EMI activity. Counsel must verify that the EMI has no Vanuatu-specific onboarding restriction and that its KYB process accepts the IC's registered-agent domicile and non-resident status.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory universal rule requires Vanuatu-registered International Company directors to appear physically at a bank branch; the International Companies Act permits fully non-resident directorship and remote incorporation. In practice, tier-1 Vanuatu domestic banks adopt a risk-based onboarding policy under the Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Act [Cap. 295] that may require at least one authorizing officer or a mandated representative to undergo a physical interview at a Port Vila branch when the ultimate beneficial ownership is complex. Remote opening is achievable if the IC uses a licensed registered agent with pre-vetted customers, supplies apostilled/certified corporate documents, and agrees to a video-identity verification protocol; the bank retains sole discretion. For time-to-market efficiency, appoint a resident natural person as an additional authorized signatory or a Vanuatu-licensed corporate services director to facilitate same-week account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident International Company with nominee shareholders and historical bearer-share characteristics
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the International Company certificate of incorporation; full register of directors and shareholders; ultimate beneficial ownership declaration on the VFSC beneficial-ownership form; registered agent confirmation of no bearer shares and no bearer warrants; board resolution designating authorized signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspect lack of economic substance despite non-resident tax-exempt status
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master SaaS subscription agreement; annual audited financial statements (Vanuatu ICs are required to prepare audited accounts); technical support or server-hosting agreement; software licensing pipeline and client onboarding records; evidence of active commercial invoicing, monthly settlement reports, and staff or external contractor agreements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border wires with mismatched or low-detail purpose narratives
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Invoice and purchase-order bundles for each SaaS subscription; bank-format payment details with explicit product reference and contract number; order flow from Stripe_Billing/ACH Direct with client identifiers; commercial contracts for vendor or subcontractor disbursements; statement from the authorized-dealer bank confirming that the transaction purpose code matches the IC's ISIC 6201 business description.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived tax immorality or zero-tax jurisdiction negative AML flag
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory tax exemption letter issued under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; legal opinion from a Vanuatu attorney confirming the IC does not conduct domestic business and is not resident for tax purposes; confirmation of no domestic tax liabilities; explanation of transparent beneficial ownership and license fee payments to VFSC; evidence that the IC deploys real proprietary technology assets.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or adverse-media mismatch involving end customers in jurisdictions outside Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening report from a Dow Jones or Refinitiv world-check tool at onboarding and ongoing intervals; geographic exclusion rules in the SaaS terms of service; KYC documentation for each commercial client (same as bank KYC); legal review confirming no OFAC/UN/FATF prohibited activity; indemnity or warranty clause in the client agreement restricting use of leased property management data in embargoed territories.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire protocol: shareholder equity injection must be sent via SWIFT MT103 from the contributor's bank to the IC's account at an authorized dealer in Vanuatu or directly to an offshore US/Singapore correspondent account. The MT103 field 50K must identify the true shareholder, field 59 must match the IC's exact registered name, and field 70 (Remittance Information) should read: 'SHARE CAPITAL INCREASE — VU__VU__VU_IC__ISIC_6201_17_PROPTECH_REALESTATE_SAAS — Board Resolution [date]'. Prior to execution, the receiving bank must hold a certified board resolution authorizing the capital issue, a share allotment ledger entry, and a confirmation from the Vanuatu registered agent that the IC has no statutory minimum paid-up capital. Shareholder loans should be documented with a loan agreement and field 70 narrative 'INTRAGROUP LOAN DISBURSEMENT — IC [date]'. Beneficial-ownership verification and source-of-funds evidence must be submitted at least 48 hours before the wire to avoid a compliance hold.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails comprise SWIFT MT103 for all foreign-currency operational and contract disbursements, with explicit invoice references in field 70; VUV local disbursements (except payroll or domestic administrative fees) are routed through the Vanuatu national retail clearing system, UPNG or VACH, depending on the authorized dealer's own clearing membership. For larger software procurement, hardware, or data-center infrastructure settlements, the treasury should use an irrevocable commercial letter of credit (LC) issued by ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Limited or BRED Bank (Vanuatu) Ltd, with the IC as applicant and the vendor as beneficiary; LC terms should specify payable at sight with SWIFT MT700 issuance and MT710 amendments. Recurring SaaS vendor bills below USD 25,000 are batched monthly and executed through the treasury system using ISO 20022 payment instructions converted to MT103 by the correspondent bank; ACH_Direct is used only for US-denominated operational accounts and never linked to the Vanuatu domestic clearing network.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards (FXA) in USD/EUR/AUD against VUV-funded operating expenses, transacted with an authorized dealer, tenor up to 12 months, subject to underlying commercial exposure and annual board-approved hedging policy

Non-deliverable vatu forwards (NDF) executed offshore through a London/New York/Singapore prime broker or authorized dealer when hedging residual VUV cost exposure, monthly or quarterly fixing against USD, tenor normally 1 to 24 months

Plain-vanilla cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) between USD and AUD/EUR for matching long-term capital-injection loans or commercial lease liabilities, concluded with a licensed international bank on ISDA/CSA terms

FX options (zero-premium aggregators excluded) only where purchased OTC with premium paid in foreign currency and embedded no recursive knockout, to protect SaaS subscription margins from adverse AUD/EUR settlement swings

FX rollover and stacking contracts prohibited without treasury model validation; leverage restricted to 1.0x—no speculative uncovered FX positions are permissible, consistent with Reserve Bank of Vanuatu policy and bank credit committees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Return (Form IR-1) containing particulars of members, directors, registered office, authorised capital, and share transfers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation each calendar year; no statutory grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 100 plus interest at 10% per annum from the anniversary date; continued default for 3 months triggers VFSC strike-off notice and removal from the International Company Register; struck-off company loses legal capacity until reinstatement order obtained within 10 years.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Declaration (UBO confirmation) tiled to the registered agent and submitted with the annual return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the annual return; no separate extension window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False or omitted beneficial ownership particulars attract monetary penalties up to VUV 500,000; persistent non-filing is a ground for VFSC administrative strike-off after 3 months.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit for Vanuatu International Companies under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]; a shareholder holding 10% or more of voting shares may require an audit, and VFSC may direct an audit upon reasonable suspicion of breach of the Act.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB; Vanuatu Accounting Standards Board permits IFRS for international company internal records; no externally filed financial statements are required.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2017, each International Company must maintain a beneficial ownership register at its registered office and file an annual confirmation of beneficial ownership with VFSC through the registered agent. Share transfers resulting in a change of beneficial ownership must be recorded in the register within 14 days and disclosed in the next annual return.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$3,000 – US$8,000 (only if shareholder-requested or VFSC-directed)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax on any company, including International Companies (ICs); no CIT statute, no capital gains tax, and no payroll tax exist in Vanuatu.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies are statutorily tax-exempt under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222); annual obligation is limited to the VFSC license fee. No taxable income, no VAT on exported cloud services, no withholding tax, and no stamp duty on offshore instruments. Tax loss carryforward is irrelevant in the absence of a CIT regime; 5-year limit noted only for hypothetical future tax reform.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC International Company Annual License Renewal Form (Form IC-AR) - submitted electronically by the licensed Registered Agent via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Portal; no conventional CIT return is filed.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: License fee and renewal application are due on each anniversary date of incorporation; renewal must be completed before the anniversary anniversary of the VFSC register, with the registered agent attesting within 30 days. Continuous non-renewal by year-end triggers administrative strike-off proceedings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name as appearing on the Certificate of Incorporation and the unique VFSC company number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the certified English constitution; no translation required but romanised characters are mandatory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: A licensed Vanuatu registered agent certifies the company's good standing and confirms maintenance of the registered office and central register in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners are permitted; the agent must hold current KYC/AML files for each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of total authorised capital; annual VFSC license fee is computed on the tiered band (standard band up to USD 10,000 with scaling above).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Minimum capital is not required; the band elected should match the constitutional share capital clauses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Listing of all directors and the company secretary with full names, addresses, nationality, and date of appointment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: One natural-person director and one secretary are required; both may be non-resident, but at least one director's service address must be contactable via the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the company has not conducted business within Vanuatu, does not own Vanuatu real property, and has not breached the International Companies Act (Cap. 222).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PropTech SaaS company must confirm that its servers, development, and customer contracting occur outside Vanuatu; local ESR substance must still be represented separately if applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Indicates whether the company carries on a 'relevant activity' under the Vanuatu Economic Substance framework (including IP business or finance and leasing) and cross-references the annual ESR notification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For pure SaaS reselling with externally owned IP, answer 'No'; if the company owns or co-owns the software IP, a 'Yes' triggers the ESR filing requirement.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal incurs VFSC administrative late fees; persistent non-payment beyond 90 days results in compulsory strike-off and dissolution. Trading while struck off is a summary offence; the company and its directors are jointly and severally liable for debts incurred during the unlicensed period.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Economic Substance Notification (ES-N1) - filed electronically with the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR) Economic Substance Directorate where the IC conducts a relevant activity.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Notification must be filed within 12 months after the end of the financial year; the directorate reviews the substance declaration and may request supporting evidence within 30 days.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of the prescribed activity class (IP business, finance and leasing, distribution and service centre, headquarters, holding company, banking, insurance, shipping, fund management).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border PropTech platforms owning source code and hosting the platform from Vanuatu must classify as 'IP business' and demonstrate active decision-making in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of premises, full-time employees, and physical assets maintained in Vanuatu in support of the relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ownership of a desk, phone line, or administrative mailbox without employees is not sufficient; local payroll records or contractor agreements must be retained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part C - Income and Expenditure Allocation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenues attributable to the relevant activity and corresponding operating expenditure booked in Vanuatu, with supporting accounting records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: US/Australian customer contracts billed through a Vanuatu entity must show a commensurate local cost base; absent local substance, the activity will be deemed located where board decisions are made.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part D - Core Income Generating Activity (CIGA)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Description of the key functions, risks, and assets generating income, including where software development, licensing negotiations, and customer support are physically performed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If all CIGA is performed in the United States or Australia by offshore employees, the ESR declaration must disclose this; recharacterisation risk and penalty exposure follow a negative finding.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the ESR notification attracts statutory penalties under the economic substance regime, automatic referral to the OECD Forum on Harmful Tax Practices, and, for repeated violations, VFSC strike-off plus disqualification of directors.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to any shareholder, whether resident or non-resident.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable - Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreements and no domestic TRC (tax residence certificate) regime. Dividends, interest, and royalties repatriated from the VU IC are free of Vanuatu source taxation. A shareholder or group entity in a treaty jurisdiction (e.g., US or Australia) must separately apply its home-country foreign tax credit or CFC rules; no local protocol applies in Vanuatu.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for royalties and 0% for interest paid by a Vanuatu IC to non-residents. Treaty rate: none available, as Vanuatu has not executed any double tax conventions. Practical caution: inbound royalties paid by a US or Australian licensee may still suffer source WHT in that home jurisdiction at the applicable statutory rate (e.g., 30% US / 15% treaty norms), and the VU IC must hold evidence of beneficial ownership to recover or reduce such foreign withholding.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None applicable in Vanuatu - no domestic transfer pricing statute, no Local File or Master File threshold, and no CbC reporting obligation for ICs. Group-level thresholds of the parent jurisdiction govern: a US parent exceeding US$850 million consolidated revenue must include the VU entity in its CbC report, and OECD-compliant Local File preparation is market practice when intercompany service fees or royalty flows exceed US$10 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu enacted its economic substance framework under the International Companies Act to meet OECD BEPS minimum standards and EU Code of Conduct demands. ICs carrying on relevant activities - banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, finance and leasing, headquarters, holding company, IP business, distribution and service centre - must maintain substantial economic presence in Vanuatu: a physical office, locally present management, commensurate employees and expenditure, and documented CIGA performed in Vanuatu. For a PropTech Real Estate SaaS entity, owning the software IP shifts the company into the 'IP business' class; pure resale of licensed third-party software may fall outside ESR scope. Annual notification and documentary proof are mandatory for in-scope companies.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Vanuatu IC as a pure tax-shelter invoice vehicle while board decisions, software development, customer contracting, and risk management are actually performed in the United States or Australia; filing an ESR notification claiming local substance with no employees and no discretionary management presence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Statutory penalties under the Vanuatu economic substance regime (fines denominated in millions of vatu per offence); compulsory VFSC strike-off; automatic reporting to the OECD Forum on Harmful Tax Practices and exchange of information with the beneficial owner's residence country.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certify false substance declarations are personally liable for penalties, may be disqualified from serving in any VFSC-regulated entity, and can be subjected to civil restitution proceedings and travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The PropTech platform holds tenant security deposits, rental escrow balances, or client trust monies without a VFSC financial services licence; or the entity processes payments on behalf of third parties without registering as a Money Service Business under the AML/CFT Act 2018.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prosecution under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018 with substantial fines and terms of imprisonment; VFSC may wind up the IC and confiscate all deposit balances as proceeds of crime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face criminal liability for undisclosed management of client funds, personal asset forfeiture, sequestration of property, and imposition of travel bans pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using an undisclosed nominee director in Vanuatu with no knowledge of the SaaS business while the beneficial owner operates entirely from a high-tax jurisdiction; failing to produce any local accounting records or substance evidence during a VFSC or foreign tax authority inquiry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compulsory strike-off and dissolution; retrospective assessment by the foreign tax authority recharacterising the entire profit as taxable in the market country, typically with penalties of up to 200% of the evaded tax; the entity is also flagged in global beneficial ownership registers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Both the nominee director and the beneficial owner may be prosecuted for tax evasion; directors have personal liability for the company's outstanding regulatory charges and can be banned from obtaining any new Vanuatu registration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Late Filing / Trading While Struck Off
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to pay the annual VFSC license fee for one full year, continuing to sign contracts and invoice customers after the company has been administratively dissolved.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Summary offence with fines and forfeiture of the right to enforce contracts concluded during the dissolved period; restoration to the register is possible only upon payment of all arrears and VFSC reinstatement fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors become jointly and severally liable for all contractual and regulatory debts incurred while the company was struck off, and may be subject to director disqualification orders in Vanuatu and the entity's market jurisdictions.
